violations.pattern: ALL service mutations must call dataStore.notify(collectionName)
violations.violation: employeeService.createExpense(), submitExpense(), createTimesheetEntry(), submitTimesheet() mutate local module arrays — never call dataStore.notify()

violations.pattern: useService() receives () => Promise<ServiceResponse<T>> — do NOT pre-strip the ServiceResponse wrapper
violations.violation: EmployeeDashboard.tsx passes .then(r => r.data) to useService — strips ServiceResponse before the hook sees it, causing the hook's success check (response.success) to fail on the raw object

violations.pattern: After useService() strips ServiceResponse, access the payload directly — NOT via .data property
violations.violation: MyProjects.tsx accesses projectsData?.data?.length and projectsData.data.map() — 'data' is not a property of PaginatedResult; correct key is 'items'

violations.pattern: All re-exports in /src/contexts/ must point to valid named exports
violations.violation: auth.ts re-exports `{ default as useAuth }` from '../app/App' — App.tsx default export is the App component, not useAuth. This export resolves to the App component, not the hook.

violations.pattern: All interactive form inputs MUST have value + onChange state bindings before submission is possible
violations.violation: MyExpenses.tsx new-expense form inputs have no value/onChange — uncontrolled, uncollectable. Submit button has no handler.

violations.pattern: Timer start/stop must call createTimesheetEntry() on stop
violations.violation: MyTimesheet.tsx timer only toggles isTimerRunning boolean — no entry creation, no service call on stop

violations.pattern: All services must use the DataStore singleton from /src/services/dataStore.ts as their data source
violations.violation: employeeService defines five isolated module-level seed arrays (seedExpenses, seedPayslips, seedTimesheets, seedTeam, seedAnnouncements). These are not in DataStore and are not reset by dataStore.reset().

violations.pattern: Authentication must validate both email AND password
violations.violation: authService.login() ignores the password entirely — only email is checked (line 34: const { email } = credentials)
violations.note: Intentional in demo mode — MUST be replaced by Supabase signInWithPassword before production

violations.pattern: Routing pattern should use RouterProvider + createBrowserRouter (Data mode per system spec)
violations.violation: App.tsx uses BrowserRouter + Routes/Route (v6 component-based pattern) instead of createBrowserRouter + RouterProvider
violations.note: Functional — not a bug. Deviation from Figma Make system spec only. Low priority unless migrating to loader-based data fetching.

violations.pattern: Duplicate workspace components should be pruned — single source of truth per portal
violations.violation: Three OrganizationDashboard files exist: OrganizationDashboard.tsx, OrganizationDashboardModern.tsx, OrganizationDashboardTest.tsx. Only OrganizationDashboardModern.tsx is imported in App.tsx routes.
